artifact.environment: production package (npm registry, tag latest) replayed in an isolated local consumer; hosted CI for the reviewed head

claims.statement: When every vulnerable copy sits on a listed path, the shipped consumers pass and print `excluded <id> for <paths> (reason)`. This holds for Bun, npm and Yarn path keys.
not_established: Controlled fixture data, not a live advisory response

claims.statement: A vulnerable copy on an unlisted path, including an npm alias, or outside the declared versions, fails every shipped consumer and names that lockfile path. This holds for Bun, npm and Yarn.
not_established: The alias entries are controlled lockfile data; no real installed alias was audited against the live service

claims.statement: An ID-only entry keeps its advisory-wide meaning in the shipped consumers. The issue's legacy-control driver still accepts a documented entry and reports an undocumented one, 3 of 3 runs.

With a scoped entry present, a missing or unparseable bun.lock makes every shipped consumer refuse, with a clear message and never an advisory-wide pass. An unreadable bun.lock (mode 000, EACCES) and bun.lock entries of unknown shape (an object instead of a tuple, or an unreadable version) make the exported helper and the shipped adapter fail closed with 'Cannot evaluate scoped audit exclusions' before any audit call. The same unreadable tree passes once it is readable again.
not_established: The registry words the missing-lockfile case differently because lockfile detection fails first; the verdict is identical
The unreadable and unknown-shape lockfile cases were run through the helper and the adapter only, not through pre-push, the registry or CI

claims.statement: The shipped 4.96.3 doctor (auditExceptionObservations) reports exactly one non-blocking observation for a documented ID-only entry, naming the file and the advisory and suggesting versions and paths. It reports none for a fully scoped entry. It reports one for a package-only entry. auditExceptionViolations is empty in all three cases.
not_established: Called through the shipped module's exported functions, not through the full `lisa doctor` command output

claims.statement: On identical trees, the shipped pre-push audit block, the registry, the adapter, the exported helper and the merge-commit CI action give the same verdict: 65 of 65 for Bun and 40 of 40 for npm and Yarn, matching the earlier local table.
not_established: The CI consumer ran the merge commit's action source on this machine, not on a GitHub runner
Only the hook's audit block ran, not the whole hook

claims.statement: The shipped doctor rejects `paths: []`. The issue's preserved driver exits 0 in 3 of 3 runs against the shipped dist, where released 4.90.0 exited 1. Every shipped consumer refuses the same entry.
In the shipped consumers, a misspelled scope key (`path`) is refused with a did-you-mean hint, and a harmless extra key (`url`) leaves the verdict unchanged.
not_established: Only `path` and `url` were exercised end to end

claims.statement: In the shipped consumers, a managed advisory-wide entry is not applied when a local scoped entry exists for the same package, and the uncovered copy still fails with a `not applied` note.
not_established: Only the layout with the managed entry in audit.ignore.config.json was exercised

claims.statement: In a live bun audit of the merged lockfile, the real advisory service reports GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5. The shipped helper and the shipped adapter both exclude it only for `eslint-plugin-react-compiler/zod`, and both exit 0.
not_established: A single live sample at 2026-11-08T14:58Z

claims.statement: tests/unit/config/zod-security-floor.test.ts ran by name in hosted CI, 9 of 9 passed.
not_established: Code-unit only; it says nothing about consumer behavior

claims.statement: At the merge commit, docs/dependency-audit-exclusions.md describes `paths` and says to prefer it over an advisory-wide exception for dev-only copies. The shipped security-audit-handling rule points to that page.
not_established: Whether a non-technical reader finds the page clear was not tested

claims.statement: npm (package-lock v3) and Yarn classic give the same verdicts in all five shipped consumers.
not_established: Yarn Berry lockfiles were not exercised
Controlled reports only; no live npm or Yarn advisory query was made

claims.statement: On the reviewed head, the hosted job 'Named Regression Specs', step 'Execute and name dependency-audit scope regression specs' (CI Quality Checks run 42488822127), ran 17 named files: 381 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed. The step succeeded.
not_established: Captured on 1e3ade8714, the merge's second parent, not on the merge commit; it applies to the merge under the ancestry rule
The 2 skipped tests (quality-audit-fail-closed, npm and yarn registry-error-body cases) were exempted by the step and proved nothing
